defensiveAbilities.name: Regeneration 40 (Deactivated by Chaotic, Mental or Orichalcum)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

This monster regains the listed number of Hit Points each round at the beginning of its turn. Its Dying condition never increases beyond Dying 3 as long as its regeneration is active. However, if it takes damage of a type listed in the regeneration entry, its regeneration deactivates until the end of its next turn. Deactivate the regeneration before applying any damage of a listed type, since that damage might kill the monster by bringing it to Dying 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Cheaters Never Prosper
defensiveAbilities.description: 50 feet. A creature within the aura who uses or benefits from an effect with the fortune trait must succeed at a DC 34 Will Saving Throw save or become Slowed 1 for 1 round (Slowed 2 on a critical failure).

defensiveAbilities.name: Clinch Victory
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature within the triumph siktempora's reach uses an action that would restore Hit Points

Effect The triumph siktempora makes a glorious fist Strike against the triggering creature. On a critical success, this Strike also disrupts the triggering action.

defensiveAbilities.name: Temporal Sense
defensiveAbilities.description: A siktempora can always roll Dimension of Time Lore for initiative. When it does, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the roll.

defensiveAbilities.name: Uncanny Pounce
defensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The triumph siktempora rolls Dimension of Time Lore for initiative

Effect The triumph siktempora Strides once and makes a claw Strike, in either order.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vie for Victory
offensiveAbilities.description: The triumph siktempora pushes themself beyond their limits to secure victory over a chosen foe. They choose one target they can see and reach with a single Stride action. They attempt to Demoralize that target, ignoring the typical limitations on distance and with no penalty for not sharing a language with the target. They then Stride and attempt one Athletics attack action (such as Grapple or Disarm) against the target.

offensiveAbilities.name: Winning Smile
offensiveAbilities.description: The triumph siktempora flashes their disarming grin at one creature within 15 feet. The target takes 10d8 Mental Damage damage (Basic DC 34 Will Saving Throw save). On a failure, the target's attacks against the triumph siktempora also become nonlethal until the end of the target's next turn.

lv4spells.name: Dimension Door (At Will)
lv4spells.description:
Opening a door that bypasses normal space, you instantly transport yourself and any items you're wearing and holding from your current space to a clear space within range you can see. If this would bring another creature with you-even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional container-the spell is lost.

Heightened (5th) The range increases to 1 mile. You don't need to be able to see your destination, as long as you have been there in the past and know its relative location and distance from you. You are temporarily immune for 1 hour.

lv7spells.name: Air Walk (Constant)
lv7spells.description: The target can walk on air as if it were solid ground. It can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.

lv7spells.name: Blink
lv7spells.description:
You blink quickly between the Material Plane and the Ethereal Plane. You gain resistance 5 to all damage (except force). You can Sustain the Spell to vanish and reappear 10 feet away in a random direction determined by the GM; the movement doesn't trigger reactions. At the end of your turn, you vanish and reappear as above.

{Spell Effect: Blink}

Heightened (+2) The resistance increases by 3.
